judge.rationale: The candidate never actually implemented the production fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, so the core bug remains unfixed and its own newly added acceptance tests fail. Additionally, the tests it wrote in `src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` do not check that `error.cause` is set to the original value or test the `undefined` rejection case, both of which are explicit acceptance criteria in the issue. The candidate also omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact. The only part of the ticket the candidate partially addressed was updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, though even that description missed the `cause` guarantee.
